run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T06:14:55Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is backed by real error spans on the frontend itself: STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate 4.985185185185186/s at 06:19:55Z, decaying to 0/s by 06:28:55Z (about 9% of the frontend's 50.492592592592594 spans/s at that minute). The errors are concentrated in exactly two dependency paths — GET /api/data → grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (the dominant one, ~0.97/s per span of that chain) and POST /api/checkout → grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (weaker, ~0.27/s). At 06:13:51–06:13:55Z the ad and payment pods were replaced by their deployments (new ReplicaSets, container Started 06:13:54/06:13:55Z, restart count 0). Neither pod has any readiness/startup/liveness probe, so both were routing targets from the second the container started; yet the ad container's stdout begins with "Ad service starting." only at 06:18:34.972878021Z, its first handled ad request is logged at 06:23:02.698481117Z, and ad's span rate is exactly 0 at every returned point from 06:17:00Z through 06:23:30Z. That matches the interval in which frontend GetAds client spans were erroring. checkout and frontend-proxy show their own error spans consistent with this propagation, and both are error-free again by ~06:24–06:29Z. What I could not verify: the gRPC status/error text of the failing spans (the Jaeger search over 06:14:55Z–06:33:55Z returned no data, a stated limit of this Run), what changed in the ad/payment pod templates (change history is not integrated; image tags stayed 2.1.3), and why ad's process took ~4.5 minutes to log its start and ~9 minutes to serve.

claims.text: Frontend ERROR span rate was 4.985185185185186/s at 06:19:55Z and fell to 0/s at 06:28:55Z, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET span rate was 50.492592592592594/s at 06:19:55Z; so error spans were roughly 9% of frontend spans at the peak minute.

At 06:19:55Z the frontend's failing operations were the /api/data chain (span_name GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds each at 0.9703703703703704/s) and the /api/checkout chain (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 0.26666666666666666/s, 0.10370370370370371/s at 06:20:55Z); tcp.connect error rate was 0.037037037037037035/s then.

Over the hour ending 06:33:55Z the frontend's ERROR-span increases were GET 407.68, GET /api/data 407.68, executing api route (pages) /api/data 407.68, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 407.68, POST 79.3, POST /api/checkout 79.3, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 79.3, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 79.3 and tcp.connect 15.25, i.e. the ad-call chain carries about five times the checkout-call chain.

checkout produced its own ERROR spans on exactly oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (server) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (client), both 87.7056 in the hour view, and its overall ERROR rate was 0.5333333333333333/s at 06:19:55Z, 0.23703703703703705/s at 06:21:55Z and 0 by 06:23:55Z.

frontend-proxy produced its own ERROR spans on span_name ingress and router frontend egress (519.5166666666667 and 486.9833333333333 over the hour view) at 2.466666666666667/s at 06:19:55Z, 0.7086498412698413/s at 06:24:55Z and 0.006535999999999999/s at 06:28:55Z, tracking the frontend error episode on the ingress path.

The ad service reported STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 at every returned point from 06:14:00Z to 06:25:00Z, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET span rate was 3.0666666666666664/s at 06:14:00Z, 3.7333333333333334/s at 06:15:00Z, exactly 0 at every point from 06:17:00Z through 06:23:30Z, and 3.533333333333333/s at 06:25:00Z (points 06:16:00Z, 06:16:30Z, 06:24:00Z and 06:24:30Z were not returned, so those instants are unknown).

The ad container's log stream (218 lines, no previous container instance) starts with "Ad service starting." at 2026-11-15T06:18:34.972878021Z and its first request line is "Targeted ad request received for [binoculars]" at 2026-11-15T06:23:02.698481117Z, continuing steadily afterwards.

Deployment ad rolled out at 06:13:52-06:13:54Z: ScalingReplicaSet ad-5f8dd7c58d 0→1 (Created pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5, Scheduled 06:13:52Z, container Started 06:13:54Z with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad already present) and old ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 scaled 1→0 with pod ad-554b849958-6z62j Killing/SuccessfulDelete at 06:13:54Z.

Deployment payment rolled out at 06:13:51-06:13:55Z: ScalingReplicaSet payment-5d565cf9b 0→1 (Created pod payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn, Scheduled 06:13:51Z, container Started 06:13:55Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment) and old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 scaled 1→0 with pod payment-55766d76b9-9fxhp Killing/SuccessfulDelete at 06:13:55Z.

Both replacement pods have no readinessProbe, startupProbe or livenessProbe (probes null), while their Ready and ContainersReady conditions are True with lastTransitionTime 2026-11-15T06:13:54Z (ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5) and 2026-11-15T06:13:55Z (payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn), restartCount 0 for both.

payment's UNSET span rate was 1.8666666666666667/s at 06:14:00Z and 1.6/s at 06:14:30Z, exactly 0 at 06:17:00Z and 06:17:30Z, then 2.688213333333333/s at 06:18:00Z and between 2.0/s and 3.0/s to 06:23:00Z; 06:15:00Z-06:16:30Z and 06:24:00Z-06:24:30Z were not returned (unknown).

payment's own logs show continuous "Charge request received."/"Transaction complete." pairs from 06:20:57.236Z to 06:23:32.993Z (457 matching lines inside 06:13:30-06:21:30Z, newest 40 shown), and checkout logs "payment went through" repeatedly from 06:22:36.977Z to 06:23:33.069Z (334 matching of 2084 lines read).

A healthy pre-incident trace at 05:57:57Z shows the /api/data dependency chain: load-generator user_get_ads → frontend-proxy ingress → router frontend egress → frontend GET → GET /api/data → executing api route (pages) /api/data → frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (rpc.grpc.status_code=0) → ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (rpc.grpc.status_code=0) → ad getAdsByCategory, all HTTP 200 / gRPC 0.

Pod inventory at query time: frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg Running, started 05:41:04Z, 0 restarts, ready; ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn started 06:13:52Z/06:13:51Z with 0 restarts; fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv has restartCount 1 with lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137.

The only other event in namespace otel-demo inside the authorized window is fraud-detection's container lifecycle: image 2.1.3-fraud-detection already present, container Created and Started at 06:15:39Z on pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv (pod name unchanged).

Other services' own error signals over the incident window: accounting, payment, ad, fraud-detection and recommendation ERROR rates were 0 or ~0.004/s (about one per hour) at the sampled points, versus frontend 4.985185185185186/s and frontend-proxy 2.466666666666667/s at 06:19:55Z.

Primary cause: the frontend request error rate was driven by availability failures of its dependencies across the ad and payment pod replacements of 06:13:51-06:13:55Z. Because neither pod has a readiness probe, ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 was a routing target from 06:13:54Z, yet ad served no spans from 06:17:00Z to 06:23:30Z and its process only logged "Ad service starting." at 06:18:34.972878021Z and handled its first request at 06:23:02.698481117Z — matching the interval in which frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans (feeding GET /api/data, ~78% of the frontend's error spans) were erroring, with recovery to 0 by 06:28:55Z.

Secondary cause: the /api/checkout → grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder component of frontend errors came from checkout's failing oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls around the payment pod replacement at 06:13:51-06:13:55Z (payment span rate 0 at 06:17:00Z and 06:17:30Z, Charge client errors 0.5333333333333333/s at 06:19:55Z decaying to 0 by 06:23:55Z). This is weaker than the ad case because payment's own error counter is 0 and its logs show successful charges from before 06:20:57Z, so the exact unavailability interval is uncertain.

ad's own error counter is 0 across every returned point including the interval with no traffic, so ad never reported failing requests; the frontend evidence points to ad being unreachable or carrying no traffic rather than ad returning error statuses.

The frontend itself shows no sign of a persistent internal fault: its pod has 0 restarts since 05:41:04Z, its error rate returns to 0 by 06:28:55Z, and ad resumes handling ad requests at 06:23:02.698481117Z, i.e. the errors track dependency availability rather than a lasting frontend defect.

Rejected: fraud-detection's OOMKilled container restart (started 06:15:39Z) as the cause of the frontend error rate. fraud-detection's own ERROR span rate was 0 at every sampled point from 06:19:55Z, and checkout's failing operation was oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, not a fraud-detection call; the OOM restart is a separate change inside the window.

Rejected: the constant flagd flag-evaluation error spans carried by ad, fraud-detection and recommendation explain the frontend burst. Those stayed at about 1 per hour (1.0329790322580645 for ad and 1.029263492063492 for fraud-detection over the hour view; ~0.004/s in the 5-minute rate) while the frontend error rate reached 4.985185185185186/s, so they differ by orders of magnitude and are unrelated to this alert.

gaps: The Jaeger trace search over 06:14:55Z-06:33:55Z returned no data (status no_data), so the gRPC status codes and error text of the failing frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans, and any ad/payment server-side spans in that window, are unverified; UNAVAILABLE specifically is inferred, not observed. The newest frontend traces this Run saw are around 05:57:57Z.

No metric samples exist before 06:14:55Z in the authorized window, so there is no pre-incident baseline and the alert's reported current value 4.422222222222222 cannot be reproduced; the alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not present in list_prometheus_rules (rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no data).

Change history is not an integrated source in this Run, so what changed in the ad and payment pod templates at 06:13:51-06:13:55Z is unknown; the container images remained ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and :2.1.3-payment, and image digests could not be read (kube_pod_container_info returned no series).

Why ad's process needed about 4.5 minutes after container start to log "Ad service starting." and about 9 minutes to serve traffic is unknown; the ad container's stdout begins only at 06:18:34.972878021Z and there is no previous container instance to read.
The frontend container's log query for 06:13:00Z-06:33:55Z returned no data, so there is no application-level error text from the affected service itself.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available and kube_pod_container_info returned no data for otel-demo, and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count / http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no series, so deployment availability and RPC/HTTP error-code breakdowns are unknown rather than zero.

No STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping, email, image-provider or kafka, so those services' error state is unknown rather than confirmed clean; only accounting, ad, checkout, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation had observable error series.

The fraud-detection OOMKill is visible only as lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled/exit 137 plus a Created/Started event at 06:15:39Z; when its container died and whether its own callers were affected was not determined.
next_steps: Pull the deployment revision/ConfigMap diff for ad and payment around 06:13:51Z from the change-history source (not integrated in this Run) to identify what triggered the simultaneous rollouts.
Review the ad service's startup path and its flagd/OTel initialization dependency to explain the ~4.5-9 minute delay between container start and first served request.

Add readinessProbe/startupProbe to the ad and payment containers so their endpoints are only ready once the gRPC server is listening, and consider maxUnavailable/PodDisruptionBudget or staggered rollouts to avoid a dependency gap like this.
Check node i-068d8c8f254eed0b1 (host of the new ad and payment pods) for resource pressure or container-start latency between 06:13 and 06:23Z.
Collect span-level evidence for 06:14:55Z-06:33:55Z, or the original frontend error payloads, to confirm the exact gRPC status returned by the failing GetAds and Charge/PlaceOrder calls.
